description: One row per MCP Quest play. It is the server-side session store, the leaderboard source and the audit record, and links a passing play to the shared Prize Claim. Claim, contact and prize data stays on Prize Claim.

columns.description: Generated primary name: station, mission, nickname and start time.
Shared Prize Claim minted when the play passed. Empty for plays that did not pass.
Contest Campaign that was active when the play started. Scopes the leaderboard so a new event starts a fresh board.
Slug of the device the play ran on, from the page's ?station= parameter.
Mission slug, for example fixit or incident-queue.
Player-chosen display name, 3 to 12 characters. Never an email address; contact details are collected only through the claim flow.
Random seed from which the judge rebuilds this play's cases on every request.
Version of the repo MCP snapshot the cases were built from, for example it-ticketing@2026-10-09. The schema name is spelled as deployed ('snaphot'); the Function App uses it as-is.
Server time the play started. The time limit and the speed bonus are measured from here.
Server time the play was submitted and graded.
True once the play has been graded. A submitted play cannot be changed.
True when every solution met its requirements and the score reached the pass mark.
True once the Prize Claim for a passing play has been created and linked.
Claim token generated at submission for a passing play. Identical to the token on the linked Prize Claim.
Final score awarded by the judge.

Grand-prize entries this play earned (same column as Plinko Play). Set by the game at submit from the score and the campaign's per-contact maximum; claim-prize creates this many entries, capped by the engine. Whole number 1 to 100 as deployed in Development; left unset for a play that earned none.
Seconds from start to submission, capped at the mission's time limit.
Tool calls the player made directly (not counting test runs).
Number of hints the player asked for.
Total test runs across all cases.
Serialized in-progress state: per-case tool choices, misses and test counts, hints and call count. Written by the Function App only.
Serialized final result: score breakdown and per-case criteria outcomes, for analytics and support.
